free_text: The patient is a 66-year-old male with a significantly elevated PSA of 34.7 ng/mL and severe LUTS (IPSS 29/35). MRI shows a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone, cT1c. Biopsy demonstrated benign histology (Gleason 0+0). Management assessment is continued surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of intervention against the risk of complications given the benign biopsy findings.
